# Vendored third-party archives.
#
# IMPORTANT -- what the sha256 here means:
#   It attests the integrity of the LFS blob WE vendored, not a digest published
#   upstream.  Neither of these archives can be checked against an upstream hash:
#   vim-*.tar.gz is produced locally with `git archive` (output depends on the
#   local git and gzip), and GitHub's auto-generated tag tarballs are not
#   byte-stable over time.  The `url` field is therefore PROVENANCE -- where the
#   bits came from -- while `sha256` is INTEGRITY of what is committed here.
#
# A fresh clone needs no network: `git lfs pull` retrieves these, and
# scripts/prepare-deps.sh verifies and extracts them.  Only scripts/add-dep.sh
# ever downloads anything, and it is used solely to onboard a NEW dependency.
#
# Format: one record per archive, blank-line separated, `key: value`.

name:     vim
version:  9.2.1125
file:     vim-9.2.1125.tar.gz
sha256:   1c24375811f58ad996d6cee37d79ace58ee8990b1515cf6df7b2406790cbb2d5
prefix:   vim-9.2.1125
url:      https://github.com/vim/vim.git
commit:   12c69acc0a1f1530dc0f0618c763bd9c07b7b6b3
date:     2026-09-21
origin:   git archive --prefix=vim-9.2.1125/ <commit>
patches:  vim
notes:    Upstream Vim. Built as an ESP-IDF component; see docs/PLAN.md Phase 2.

name:     esp-emu
version:  0.43.0
file:     esp-emu-0.43.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
sha256:   ec875a317c671a40c32833c6caba92efca4a5b1b89ce09a74efba82f99200243
prefix:   esp-emu-0.43.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
url:      https://github.com/espressif/esp-emulator/releases/download/v0.43.0/esp-emu-0.43.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
origin:   upstream release asset, verified against its published SHA256SUMS
patches:  -
notes:    Host-side emulator, not firmware. x86_64 Linux only; other hosts must
          add their own arch archive. Upstream SHA256SUMS kept alongside as
          esp-emu-0.43.0.SHA256SUMS.

name:     spleen
version:  2.2.0
file:     spleen-2.2.0.tar.gz
sha256:   ec42925c6b56d2138c862b2f97147c872e472f674bf03423417d827a08d69a89
prefix:   spleen-2.2.0
url:      https://github.com/fcambus/spleen/releases/download/2.2.0/spleen-2.2.0.tar.gz
origin:   upstream download via scripts/add-dep.sh
patches:  -
notes:    Frederic Cambus's bitmap font, BSD-2-Clause. The display console
          (components/esp_display) uses its BDF files (6x12, 8x16, and 12x24 /
          16x32 for the overlay), converted to C tables at build time by
          scripts/bdf2c.py.

name:     terminus
version:  4.49.1
file:     terminus-font-4.49.1.tar.gz
sha256:   d961c1b781627bf417f9b340693d64fc219e0113ad3a3af1a3424c7aa373ef79
prefix:   terminus-font-4.49.1
url:      https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/terminus-font/terminus-font-4.49/terminus-font-4.49.1.tar.gz
origin:   upstream download via scripts/add-dep.sh
patches:  -
notes:    Dimitar Zhekov's Terminus Font, SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL.TXT in the archive).
          The display console uses ter-u20n.bdf and ter-u22n.bdf (10x20 and
          11x22), converted to C tables at build time by scripts/bdf2c.py: the
          sizes Spleen lacks between 8x16 and 12x24.
